positions.title: Postdoctoral Researchers in 2D Quantum Materials, Optoelectronic, and Photovoltaic Devices
positions.description:
The QPOD Lab at the Institute of Low-Dimensional Quantum Materials, Hubei University of Technology, Wuhan, China, invites applications for postdoctoral research positions.
The successful candidates will conduct research in one or more of the following areas: two-dimensional materials and van der Waals heterostructures, hot-carrier and multiple-exciton-generation photovoltaics, quantum optoelectronic devices, contact and interface engineering, ultrafast carrier dynamics, nanophotonics, and exciton–polariton physics.
Postdoctoral researchers will have opportunities to develop independent research ideas, collaborate with international research teams, supervise graduate students, publish high-impact work, and participate in national and international research proposals.
positions.requirements:
Applicants should:
Hold a PhD in physics, materials science, electrical engineering, nanotechnology, photonics, or a related discipline.
Have research experience in two-dimensional materials, semiconductor devices, photovoltaics, optoelectronics, nanofabrication, optical spectroscopy, ultrafast measurements, or related areas.
Demonstrate a strong publication record and the ability to conduct independent research.
Have good scientific writing and communication skills.
Be highly motivated and able to work effectively in a collaborative and interdisciplinary environment.
Experience in device fabrication, van der Waals heterostructure assembly, electrical and optoelectronic characterization, cleanroom processing, or optical spectroscopy will be advantageous.
positions.apply: Applicants should send the following documents to paulkamal@hbut.edu.cn or ashokmondal@hbut.edu.cn:  A detailed curriculum vitae; a brief cover letter describing research interests and suitability for the position; a complete publication list; contact details of two or three academic referees. Please use the email subject line:  Application for Postdoctoral Position – QPOD Lab. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the positions are filled.
